source.notes: Verified 2026-07-01 by pypdf extraction of the OSTI copy: 'gamma_111 for stoichiometric Ni3Al is 0.188 J/m^2' (their higher-accuracy supplementary value: 0.185 J/m^2). DFT RANGE is method-condition dependent: earlier relaxed-condition DFT gives 0.181 J/m^2; idealized (unrelaxed, perfect-lattice) DFT/CE approaches give ~0.31-0.32 J/m^2 (Crudden et al. 310 mJ/m^2; Dodaran et al. CE 320.7 mJ/m^2).

unresolved.note: The verified DFT values for B2-NiAl a0/B0 (Ward et al. Table 1) are GGA-PW91, not strictly PBE. A dedicated PBE-labelled a0/B0 pair for B2 NiAl was not verified this session (Materials Project mp-1487 page values were not fetched). PW91 vs PBE differences for these quantities are typically <0.5%.

Only the '~195 mJ/m2' consensus statement was verified; per-study primary values (Baluc et al. 1991; Hemker & Mills 1993; Baither et al. 2002; Douin et al. 1986) were not individually fetched. Treat 195 mJ/m^2 as approximate with ~+/-10% scatter.

The Kim/Meschel/Nash/Chen dataset contains only the Debski et al. (2013) solution-calorimetry record for AlNi3; the frequently cited Kleppa-lab direct-synthesis value for Ni3Al was not present and was not separately verified.
